lemma regularFamily (β : ℝ) : (raw G n c b β).RegularFamily b := by
  have he (i : ℕ) : b.Regular ((dictionary G n).reg i).support ((raw G n c b β).E i) ∧
      ((raw G n c b β).E i) 1=0 ∧ ∀ x y,logHessian ((raw G n c b β).E i) x y = 0 := by
    change b.Regular (eInfo _).support _ ∧ _
    simp only [raw,Ovens.Pipes.pours,payload]; split
    · rcases name (Sheet n) i with p|s
      · exact ⟨times_reg _ (accrual_regular ..),accrual_null ..⟩
      exact ⟨zero_reg,rfl,fun x y => by simp [written,logHessian]⟩
    exact ⟨zero_reg,rfl,fun x y => by simp [logHessian]⟩
  exact ⟨fun i => (he i).1,fun i => (he i).2.1,fun i _ x y _ _ => (he i).2.2 x y⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The Wilson start is a regular family.

theorem forcedFamily (h : Decent c b) (β : ℝ) : (raw G n c b β).ForcedFamily b := by
  have he i : (raw G n c b β).K i = if fixed (Foot n) i then paid c b (name (Foot n) i) β else 0 := rfl
  refine ⟨fun i k U => ?_,fun _ _ _ => Iff.rfl,fun i => ?_,fun _ => MeasurableSet.univ, fun i => ?_, fun _ _ _ _ _ => rfl,fun i U hp => ?_⟩
  · rw [he]; split; exact paid_gauge ..; rfl
  · rw [he]; split; exact paid_meas ..; exact measurable_const
  · rw [he]; split
    · exact paid_final h _ _
    intro U V _ _; rfl
  rw [he] at hp; split at hp
  · exact permit_paid _ β U hp
  exact (hp rfl).elim

proof_context.conclusion: The Wilson start is a forced family.

theorem moves (s : Signed) (x : Site n) (β : ℝ) : Nonempty ((raw G n c b β).Moves s x) := by
  refine ⟨{ ep := sends (sheetAction s x), kp := sends (footAction s x), reg_site := fun i => ?_,reg_support := fun i => ?_,
            forced_support := fun i => ?_,forced_inventory := fun i => ?_,forced_tests := fun i U => Iff.rfl,
            valuesE := fun i U => ?_,valuesK := fun i U => ?_ }⟩
  · change (eInfo _).site = affine s x (eInfo _).site
    rw [name_sends,eInfo_transport]
  · change (eInfo _).support = Finset.image _ (eInfo _).support
    rw [name_sends,eInfo_transport]
  · change (name (Foot n) _).val.1 = (name (Foot n) i).val.1.image _
    rw [name_sends,foot_trans]
  · change (name (Foot n) _).val.2 = (name (Foot n) i).val.2.image _
    rw [name_sends,foot_trans]
  · simp only [raw,pours,payload,name_sends,fixed_sends]
    split <;> first | exact written_oriented .. | exact rfl
  · simp only [raw,pours,payload,name_sends,fixed_sends]
    split <;> first | exact paid_oriented .. | exact rfl

proof_context.conclusion: The Wilson start is covariant under signed permutations and translations.

theorem ink (ht : b.threshold ≤ threshold G b.order b.power) (hc : c.direct ≤ 1) {q : ℝ} (hy : ‖β‖ ≤ v)
    (hp : book G b v ≤ q) : (raw G n c b β).EBound b q := by
  let E := fun i : Sheet n => i.elim (fun _ => ‖weight c β‖*item G b) (fun _ => (0:ℝ))
  let T := fun i : ℕ => if fixed (Sheet n) i then E (name (Sheet n) i) else 0
  have he : ∀ i, b.supBounds ((raw G n c b β).reg i).site ((raw G n c b β).reg i).support ((raw G n c b β).E i) (T i) := by
    intro i
    simp only [T,raw,Ovens.Pipes.pours,payload,dictionary]; split
    · cases h : name (Sheet n) i with
      | inl p => exact times_bound _ (accrual_fit p ht)
      | inr s => exact zero_bound
    exact zero_bound
  refine ⟨T,he,fun x => Padded.budget (α:=Sheet n) ?_ (fun i => ?_) ((sum_items x hy hc).trans hp)⟩
  · intro i; change (if _ then b.mass _ (ite ..) else _) = _; by_cases h : fixed (Sheet n) i
    · rw [if_pos h,if_pos h]; rfl
    rw [if_neg h,if_neg h]; simp [BudgetPoint.mass]
  split
  · apply mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le
    simpa only [T,E,name_index,fixed_index,if_true] using (show 0 ≤ T (index i) from (he _).1)
  exact le_rfl

proof_context.conclusion: The Wilson start has a regular `EBound`.

theorem Loan.kernel (h : Loan b l σ κ γ) (hc : Decent c b) (hb : l ≤ β) :
    (raw G n c b β).KBound b (Real.exp γ-1) := by
  refine ⟨cash n b σ,fun i => ⟨cash_pos _,fun U => ?_⟩,fun x => ?_⟩
  · exact (forced_money hc h.forced h.slope h.allows hb i U).trans <|
      mul_le_of_le_one_left (cash_pos _) (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith only [h.forced]))
  let f := fun i => if x ∈ extent n i then b.mass (extent n i) (cash n b σ i) else 0
  have hf i : 0 ≤ f i := by unfold f BudgetPoint.mass; split <;> first | exact le_rfl | exact mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (cash_pos _)
  have H := h.packets.hit (n:=n) x
  have he i : f i ≤ (if x ∈ extent n i then cash n b σ i * Real.exp ((b.supportExponent+1)*coverNumber b.B (extent n i)) else 0) := by
    unfold f; split
    · rw [BudgetPoint.mass,mul_comm]; have := cash_pos (n:=n) (b:=b) (σ:=σ) i; gcongr; linarith
    rfl
  have H' := H.2.1.of_nonneg_of_le hf he
  exact ⟨hf,H',(H'.tsum_le_tsum he H.2.1).trans H.2.2⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The Wilson start has a forced `KBound`.
